title: WAVV Pricing in 2026: Single Line, Multi Line and Discounts
summary: WAVV Single Line is $99 and Multi Line $149 per seat a month billed monthly, or $69.30 and $104.30 billed annually. Numbers are $1 a month. 7-day free trial.
body_markdown:
WAVV publishes prices for both of its dialer plans. Single Line is $99 per seat a month billed monthly, and Multi Line is $149. Quarterly billing takes 15% off, to $84.15 and $126.65. Annual billing takes 30% off, to $69.30 and $104.30. Teams of five or more seats get a further 5% to 15% off. Both plans list unlimited minutes and a 7-day free trial. Phone numbers are $1 each a month. The pages were read on November 18, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every WAVV detail below comes from WAVV's own plans page, help center and Terms of Service, opened on November 18, 2026. The plans page loads its prices with a script, so it was read in Chrome. No price here comes from a review site. No WAVV account or trial was used and nothing was tested. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. WAVV](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-wavv) .


## WAVV pricing at a glance


WAVV's[plans page](https://www.wavv.com/plans) has a switch between monthly, quarterly and annual billing, and a menu for the number of seats. Each price is shown as a "starting at" price per seat a month.


WAVV plans per seat a month for 1 to 4 seats, as listed on WAVV's own plans page, read on November 18, 2026. Plan Billed monthly Billed quarterly Billed annually Seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


Single Line $99 $84.15 $69.30 None stated 7 days A power dialer on one line, with unlimited minutes, call recordings and "1 free phone number"


Multi Line $149 $126.65 $104.30 None stated 7 days All Single Line features, plus up to 3 dialing lines per seat


The seat menu has four options: 1-4 seats, 5-9 at 5% off, 10-19 at 10% off and 20 or more at 15% off. The page showed these prices for each one.

The plans page names no CRM and shows one set of prices. WAVV's[integrations page](https://www.wavv.com/integration) lists HighLevel, HubSpot, REDX, PropertyRadar and Wise Agent. For HighLevel (GoHighLevel), WAVV's[billing FAQ](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/10139045-am-i-billed-through-my-crm-or-wavv) says the marketplace app is free to add and payment goes through WAVV.


For REDX, PropertyRadar and Wise Agent, the integrations page says WAVV is turned on inside those products. WAVV's[Terms of Service](https://www.wavv.com/terms-of-service) say the fee schedule is on WAVV's website or the client's reseller's website. WAVV's own pages state no separate price for those three.


## What changes the real cost of WAVV


The seat price is public. The bill also depends on the billing term, the number of seats, phone numbers, texting and the refund rules.


### Monthly, quarterly or annual billing


WAVV's[pricing update article](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/13917416-release-wavv-pricing-update-effective-with-wallet-release-2026) says a quarterly plan is billed once every quarter and an annual plan once a year. One Multi Line seat at $104.30 a month works out to $1,251.60 for the year, charged at once.


### Seat-count discounts


The same article says the seat discount and the billing term discount add together. A 5-seat team on annual billing gets 35% off, and a team of 20 or more gets 45% off.


It also says one WAVV subscription covers a whole team across HighLevel sub-accounts, and that the charge is by seat, not by sub-account.


### Who needs a seat


WAVV's[dialer seats article](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/12834292-understanding-wavv-dialer-seats) says a user needs a paid dialer seat to make calls. Removing a team member does not lower the seat count. A seat removed from the subscription stays active until the end of the billing cycle, and the change takes effect at renewal.


### Phone numbers and the Wallet


Phone numbers are $1 per number a month. They are billed apart from the subscription, through a prepaid balance called the WAVV Wallet. WAVV's[Wallet FAQ](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/14140234-wavv-wallet-faqs) says auto-recharge cannot be turned off and that a Wallet balance is not refundable.


WAVV's pages disagree on one point. The plans page lists "1 free phone number" on Single Line. The Wallet FAQ says WAVV numbers are not free, and that some older accounts have grandfathered free numbers. Budget $1 a month for each number.


### Texting


Texting is not in the plan price. WAVV's[Messenger article](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/13878739-wavv-messenger) says sending texts needs A2P 10DLC registration, with a $19 registration fee and a further fee if the registration is resubmitted. It also names an ongoing campaign maintenance fee and a small cost per message. The article states no amount for those two.


### Minutes, countries and Spam Protection


Both plans list unlimited minutes. WAVV's[countries article](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/8530679-what-countries-and-numbers-are-supported) says WAVV supports phone numbers with US and Canadian area codes only.


The pricing update article says Spam Protection is now included with every dialer subscription, with no separate billing.


### The free trial


The plans page offers a 7-day free trial on either plan. WAVV's[trial article](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/11187889-2-how-to-start-your-wavv-free-trial) says the trial starts through the purchase steps and that the account is not charged until the 7 days are up. The Wallet FAQ says a trial account gets $10 in Wallet funds, enough for up to 10 numbers.


### Cancellation and refunds


WAVV's[cancellation article](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/17764023-cancelling-your-wavv-subscription-and-refunds) says the account owner can cancel at any time and keeps access to the end of the billing cycle. Subscription charges are not refundable, with one exception. WAVV refunds the most recent charge if the customer asks within 7 days of it and has placed no calls and sent no texts in that time. This can be used once per account, and on an annual plan the window comes once a year.


The same rule is in section 10.2 of the Terms of Service, effective September 22, 2026. The article also says cancelling the CRM does not cancel WAVV.


## Who WAVV fits and who it does not


WAVV fits a team that works in one of the CRMs it lists. Its[HighLevel page](https://www.wavv.com/highlevel) says the dialer is embedded in GoHighLevel. In HubSpot, WAVV's[HubSpot article](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/16220242-release-wavv-in-hubspot) says it runs through a Chrome extension and works on every HubSpot plan.


It fits a single user or a small team that wants a public price. The smallest seat option is 1-4 seats, and the plans page states no minimum.


WAVV is a weaker fit for a team that wants more than three lines. Its[power dialer page](https://www.wavv.com/power-dialer) says WAVV sits between a power dialer and a parallel dialer on purpose, and Multi Line stops at three lines per seat.


It is also a weaker fit for a team that calls outside the US and Canada, or that works in two CRMs. WAVV's[HubSpot FAQ](https://help.wavv.com/en/articles/17517253-wavv-for-hubspot-faqs) says a WAVV account works with one CRM at a time.

The[Trellus power dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) plan, Power, is $99.99 per seat per month. On monthly billing, WAVV and Trellus list about the same seat prices: $99 and $149 against $99.99 and $149.99. WAVV is lower on quarterly or annual billing and for five or more seats, and has a free trial. Trellus lists no term or seat discounts. Its Power + Parallel plan dials up to five numbers at once, against three on WAVV Multi Line. Texting is not listed in Trellus plans.


Trellus works in GoHighLevel and HubSpot too: see[Trellus for GoHighLevel](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/gohighlevel) and[Trellus for HubSpot](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/hubspot) . The wider field is in the guide to[cold calling dialers](https://www.trellus.ai/post/best-cold-calling-dialers) .


## Frequently asked questions


### How much does WAVV cost per seat?


WAVV's plans page lists Single Line at $99 per seat a month and Multi Line at $149, billed monthly, for 1 to 4 seats. Quarterly billing is $84.15 and $126.65. Annual billing is $69.30 and $104.30. Phone numbers are $1 each a month on top.


### Does WAVV have a free trial?


Yes. The plans page offers a 7-day free trial on either plan. WAVV's help center says the account is not charged until the 7 days are up. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid the first charge.


### Is WAVV's price different in HighLevel and HubSpot?


WAVV's plans page names no CRM and shows one set of prices. Its billing FAQ says HighLevel users pay WAVV directly. For REDX, PropertyRadar and Wise Agent, WAVV's own pages state no separate price.


### How do WAVV's discounts work?


Quarterly billing takes 15% off and annual billing 30%. Teams of 5 to 9 seats get 5% off, 10 to 19 seats 10% and 20 or more seats 15%. WAVV says the two discounts add together, so 20 seats on annual billing get 45% off.


### What costs extra on WAVV?


Phone numbers are $1 each a month, paid from a prepaid Wallet. Texting needs A2P 10DLC registration, with a $19 registration fee, an ongoing campaign fee and a cost per message. Spam Protection is included.


### Can I get a refund from WAVV?


Only in one case. WAVV refunds the most recent subscription charge if you ask within 7 days of it and have placed no calls and sent no texts in that time. This can be used once per account. Wallet balances are not refundable.
